habit-tracker/features/flexible_layouts_: Print 1, 2, 3, or 4 charts on a single A4 page.
habit-tracker/features/generic_option_de: A simple 31-day tracker is available for any use case.
habit-tracker/features/print_ready_desc: Optimized for printing and can be downloaded as a high-quality JPG.
habit-tracker/features/privacy_first_des: All processing and generation happens directly in your browser. No data is sent to a server.
habit-tracker/features/smart_year_charts: Automatically adjusts for the correct number of days in each month and highlights weekends for a selected year.
habit-tracker/how_to_use/step1: Choose a layout option to determine how many charts are printed per page.
habit-tracker/how_to_use/step2: Select a 'Specific Year' to create a tracker for that year, which automatically marks weekends and adjusts days per month.
habit-tracker/how_to_use/step3: Alternatively, choose 'Not Specific' for a generic 31-day tracker.
habit-tracker/how_to_use/step4: Click 'Print' to send the chart to your printer or 'Download' to save it as a JPG image.
habit-tracker/note: Generate and print habit tracking tables for monitoring daily habits throughout the year.
habit-tracker/tags: health, habit, tracking, printable, productivity, table
